newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom registers 2nd TeleNotes prospectus.
newsitem.headline: Telecom registers 2nd TeleNotes prospectus.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand said on Tuesday it had registered a second prospectus for its TeleNotes via TCNZ Finance Ltd.
TeleNotes are unsecured subordinated capital notes with fixed interest rates between specified election dates.
The prospectus said Telecom can raise up to NZ$250 million with the potential for oversubscriptions of the same amount.
A spokesman said Telecom was flexible on the amount raised, saying the retail interest rate environment at present was difficult. An institutional raising was likely, he added.
The notes initially have an a rate of 7.35 percent for five years to September 15, 2002 or 7.25 percent for nine years to September, 2006.
Interest will be payable twice a year and minimuum applications will be for $5,000.
